description: This file defines the 'SaveWorkShiftController' class, which manages the pre-render logic for handling work shift data within the OrangeHRM application's admin plugin. It sets up Vue.js components with relevant properties based on request attributes, facilitating editing or creating new work shifts.

classes.name: SaveWorkShiftController
classes.description: Controller for handling the saving or editing of work shifts, extending AbstractVueController and utilizing traits for configuration services.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by setting up the appropriate component and properties based on whether the request has an 'id' attribute, indicating an edit or create operation.
